# 1 Enoch Chapter 53 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**53:1** My eyes saw a deep valley with gaping mouths. All who live on earth, on the sea, and on the islands will bring it tribute and offerings and tokens of submission — but the valley will never be filled.

**53:2** These hands have done lawless things. Sinners devour everyone they oppress through lawlessness — but the sinners themselves will be destroyed before the Lord of Spirits. They will be driven from the face of the earth and will perish forever.

**53:3** For I saw the angels of punishment dwelling there, preparing all the instruments of Satan.

**53:4** I asked the angel of peace who was with me: "Who are these instruments being prepared for?"

**53:5** He said: "They are being made ready for the kings and the powerful of this earth — to destroy them."

**53:6** "After this, the Righteous and Elect One will bring his holy community into the open. From that time on, they will never be hindered again, in the name of the Lord of Spirits."

**53:7** These mountains will not hold their ground before his righteousness as they do now; the hills will become springs of water, and the righteous will finally have rest from the oppression of sinners.

---

*PNEUMA notes: The "deep valley with gaping mouths" (v. 1) is the judgment pit — it receives all the wealth and tribute of the world and is never satisfied, echoing Sheol in Isa 5:14 ("Sheol has enlarged its appetite"). The "instruments of Satan" (v. 3) are punishment tools wielded by angels — a striking image of the adversary's own weapons turned to serve divine justice.*
